No Seeds

Safety

Effective October 14, 2026 · Beta

NO SEEDS DOES NOT CONDUCT CRIMINAL BACKGROUND CHECKS OR IDENTITY VERIFICATION ON ITS MEMBERS.

We review every profile before it goes live, but that review is not a background check and cannot confirm who someone is. These habits keep dating safer.

Before you meet

  1. Keep chatting in the app until you feel comfortable. Be wary of anyone who rushes to move the conversation elsewhere.
  2. Never send money, gift cards, cryptocurrency or financial details, however good the story.
  3. Look the person up, and consider a short video call first.
  4. Don't share your home address, workplace or daily routine early on.

On the date

  1. Meet in a busy public place. The date planner only suggests public venues.
  2. Get there and home on your own, with your phone charged.
  3. Tell a friend where you're going, who you're meeting, and when you'll be back.
  4. Keep your drink with you at all times.
  5. Leave whenever you feel uncomfortable. You don't owe anyone an explanation.

If something goes wrong

  • In an emergency, call 911.
  • In the app, open the chat and use the menu to Report, Unmatch or Block. We review every report.
  • For anything else, email thegiftedbystarr@gmail.com.

Report intimate images shared without consent

Under the federal TAKE IT DOWN Act, you can ask us to remove an intimate image or video of you, real or AI-generated, that was posted or shared on No Seeds without your consent. You don't need a No Seeds account.

Email thegiftedbystarr@gmail.com with the subject "Intimate image removal request" and include:

  1. Your full name and a way to contact you.
  2. Enough detail to find the image, such as the member's first name and city, a description, or a screenshot.
  3. A statement that you are the person shown (or are authorized to act for them) and that, in good faith, you believe it was shared without consent.
  4. Your electronic signature: type your full name.

We will remove the image, and make reasonable efforts to remove any copies we know of, within 48 hours of a valid request. We may also remove the account that shared it. If we don't act, you can report it to the Federal Trade Commission at TakeItDown.ftc.gov.

Other concerns

To report harassment, scams, fake profiles, or anyone under 18, use Report in the app or email thegiftedbystarr@gmail.com.
